new.where: Automation's question card, in the line Turns on {0} (Automation_Ask_TurnsOn_Format), when a program asks to switch to a profile that turns on Head Tracking's UDP input

Automation's question card, one line for each profile and each extra that listens on the network it would turn on: when a program turns such an extra on in the profile in force, saves the current setup into a profile, turns on Switch Profiles by Game, adds a game to a profile's list, or imports a profile. {0} is the profile's name as the user gave it, or the default profile's own name (Profile_Default), {1} the extra's name, such as Web Controller
